comparison.interpretation: Exact typed answer/status agreement with the already public authored key; not independent factual truth or population validation.

method.completion_order: The separate authored-key comparison occurred after all original blind judgments were finished and saved.
method.continuity: One LLM agent rederived the cases sequentially with shared task context; this was not a fresh independent test session for each case.
limits: Agreement with the authored expected key confirms coherence under this LLM judgment and task framing; it is not semantic proof.
No human validation, citation entailment validation, comprehension test or representative population accuracy estimate is established.
The complete source packets and shared cross-case context differ from partial retrieval and per-case fresh-session answer tests.
Original source-span bounds validate coordinates and original-kind references only; they do not establish that cited prose entails the rationale or every answer.
These supplemental judgments and comparison leave the authored bank, authored keys and primary study scores unchanged.
method.model_configuration_attestation: Underlying model identity and configuration were not independently attested. No distinct model-family independence claim is made.
method.reviewer_method: single blind LLM rederivation; not human validation
method.task_framing: The reviewer received the normal typed answer contracts, including scoped dates, normalization and hold policy.
method.unit: All 96 authored fictional histories and their 288 tasks; full supplied source packets.

provenance.canonical_hash_scope: The canonical hash is independently computable from each public review object. It is distinct from the attested original raw byte hash.
provenance.canonical_judgment_hash_recipe: SHA256(UTF8(json.dumps(review, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False))); no final newline.
provenance.raw_judgment_hash_attestation: Per-case raw byte hashes were checked against retained original private judgment files and the separately executed comparison proof. Those raw files remain private and unchanged; the public checker does not claim to reconstruct or independently verify their raw bytes.
